hostObligations: Default locale affects selected zero-argument lowercase calls; no locale failure observed.
Tick/time/random/interpolator state can affect selection and diagnostics; reads are not automatically pure.
Immutable container copies do not make contained cache/value readers deeply immutable.
Effective registry initialization, thread ownership, snapshot generation and cache invalidation remain actual consumer obligations.
Dropping cache entries releases that cache owner only; other owners and physical reclamation are separate.
limits: No actual game property, registry binding, graphical input, transformed pipeline or renderer invocation.
Source identities do not prove decompiler correctness. Apparent variant cast rejected by original bytecode inspection.
The selected 33 handlers and33adapter records do not complete vanilla property/tint registries or 28 Polytone managers.
